scripts.dev: npm run migrate && concurrently -n fe,be -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @webonone/support-frontend" "npm run dev -w @webonone/support-backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui-kit --prefix .. && npm run build:theme --prefix .. && npm run build:i18n --prefix .. && npm run build -w @webonone/support-frontend && npm run build -w @webonone/support-backend
scripts.deploy: npm run env:apply --prefix .. && npm run build && npm run stage:deploy
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w @webonone/support-frontend && npm run type-check -w @webonone/support-backend
